h: The Third Meal Reveals Love Beyond Every Accusation

p: that the three pesukim of Birkas Kohanim
הֵם כְּנֶגֶד ג׳ סְעוּדוֹת שֶׁל שַׁבָּת
correspond to the three meals of Shabbos,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁנִּרְאֶה גַּם מֵהָרַמְבַּ״ן זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה
as also appears from the Ramban, of blessed memory.
corresponds to the meal of Shabbos night,
for the blessing is in eating,
and as has been explained many times.
which are derived from the pasuk (Shemos 16:25)
which corresponds to the meal of Shabbos night.
And from this we said there is support
for what is written in the holy Zohar
even on the day of Shabbos too";
that the main mitzvah of the meal is at night;
וְהוּא כְּנֶגֶד יִצְחָק אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
and this corresponds to Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him,
who said "and I ate of all" (Bereishis 27:33)
"His light will rest upon it," etc.;
וְהוּא כְּנֶגֶד אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
and this corresponds to Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him:
"May Hashem lift His face toward you"
which is the time of the Will of Wills,
שֶׁהוּא כְּנֶגֶד יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
which corresponds to Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him;
וְעַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ (בְּרָכוֹת כ, ב)
and according to what they said (Berachos 20b):
yet You show favor to Yisrael,
as it is written, 'May Hashem lift His face toward you'!
וְכִי לֹא אֶשָּׂא פָּנִים לְיִשְׂרָאֵל וְכוּלֵּי
And shall I not show favor to Yisrael?" etc.
וְהַיְינוּ עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁכָּתַב הָאֲרִיזַ״ל
That is, according to what the Arizal wrote,
And this is because Yaakov is called
as it is written, 'My son,' etc.");
for a father who loves his son
And therefore we say at this meal:
"Outside they wait and do not enter,
is the name of the husk of Amalek
for he is like a dog
and mainly about what is said (Yeshayahu 60:21):
and in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 23a):
and says that it is not so.
And about this they said (Tanchuma, Ki Seitzei 10)
that they would cut off the circumcisions of Yisrael
"Take for Yourself what You have chosen";
And likewise Haman, of his seed
"There is none who knows how to slander
that is, in his accusing Yisrael
And when there is revealed at this meal
the aspect of the Will of Wills,
then all the accusations are nullified,
וְאָז לְבַר נַטְלִין וְלָא עָאלִין וְכוּלֵּי
and then "outside they wait and do not enter," etc.,
"He will put them in their holes,
and they will hide among the rocks";
because Hashem, may He be blessed,
who are children to the Omnipresent;
and is there any claim or accusation
against one who loves and shows favor to his son?
"And you shall be a treasure to Me";
בְּשֵׁם הַיְּהוּדִי הַקָּדוֹשׁ זֵכֶר צַדִּיק לִבְרָכָה
in the name of the Holy Yid, may the memory of the tzaddik be a blessing,
that it is like a segulah,
For Yaakov Avinu's bed was complete;
that although Esav was born of him,
and on that account was circumcised as well
that he was not circumcised at his proper time
he did not want to circumcise himself;
to uproot the name Yisrael from himself;
and therefore he is called "a Yisrael apostate"
Which is not so with Yaakov,
uproot the name Yisrael from himself;
And as is written in the holy Zohar
that they are liable at that hour to Gehinnom,
And even regarding one of whom the Gemara says
and he does not recognize him
does not recognize that he is circumcised
and does not bring him up
nevertheless his status is that of one circumcised;
and Eliyahu, the angel of the covenant,
שֶׁהוּא עַל כָּל בְּרִית מִילוֹת שֶׁל יִשְׂרָאֵל
who is present at every bris milah of Yisrael,
and then he too will be rectified
